## Experience

### Surveillance Supervisor, Epidemiologist III
::: {.meta}
Nebraska Department of Health and Human Services. Lincoln, Nebraska. September 2025 to present.
:::

Supervision of overdose, injury, violent death, and highway safety surveillance for a state population of roughly two million. Programs include the prescription drug monitoring program, OD2A, NVDRS, SUDORS, suicide surveillance, EMS data, and syndromic surveillance in ESSENCE. Linkage across prescription drug monitoring, EMS, hospital discharge, vital records, and overdose mapping data. Reporting and coordination with CDC, the Bureau of Justice Assistance, and NHTSA program requirements.

### Graduate Assistant and doctoral researcher
::: {.meta}
University of Nebraska Medical Center, College of Public Health. Omaha, Nebraska. August 2021 to August 2025.
:::

Occupational and environmental epidemiology. Study design, primary data collection, and analysis for four peer-reviewed papers and a dissertation on livestock worker injury. Instrument design in REDCap. Analysis in R, SAS, and STATA.
